subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make OpenAI-compatible HTTP handlers ignore a generic body `model` for agent-target validation?
rationale: Both choices are defensible compatibility contracts, and changing the current validation semantics affects public OpenAI-compatible clients.

options.title: Header wins
options.body: Treat a valid agent header as the selected agent, ignore the body `model` for agent-target validation, and keep `x-openclaw-model` as the explicit backend override.

options.title: Body model remains required
options.body: Keep current validation and update docs/examples to say SDK callers must send `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` even when using the header.

options.title: Defer to a broader API design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers decide the same precedence for chat completions, Responses, and embeddings together.

recommendation.title: Header wins
recommendation.body: Treat a valid agent header as the selected agent, ignore the body `model` for agent-target validation, and keep `x-openclaw-model` as the explicit backend override.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the agent-first OpenAI-compatible contract and endpoint expansion now governing this behavior.
